item.title: FDD massive MIMO via UL/DL channel covariance extrapolation and active channel sparsification
item.description: We propose active channel sparsification, a method of training multi-user MIMO Downlink channels in FDD mode with any given pilot length, while maximizing the effective channel matrix rank. IEEE Transactions on Wireless Communications, 2019.
